requirements.statement: Generated artifacts SHALL remain semantically distinct from non-authoritative bootstrap maintenance source and SHALL require structural authorization at their configured locations.
FS0 SHALL expose exactly one canonical bootstrap invocation surface that is machine-resolvable from repository state.
The canonical bootstrap invocation surface SHALL contain only invocation concerns and delegate substantive behavior to separately identified implementation.
Once copied into the target repository, the bootstrap payload SHALL require no semantic, template, generator, or script input from the originating bootstrap environment.
Bootstrap SHALL install the complete successor repo-spec Design Proposal seed set before cutover.
Each installed successor Design Proposal SHALL have one canonical structured read representation.
After cutover, authoritative determination SHALL use accepted authoritative read surfaces and SHALL NOT use non-authoritative bootstrap maintenance source as fallback authority.
FS0 SHALL retain one machine-resolvable non-authoritative bootstrap maintenance-source and generation role after cutover.
Exactly one canonical repository-structure configuration SHALL be the sole instance-level source of filesystem permission beneath the repository root.
A present filesystem object beneath the repository root without applicable positive structural authorization SHALL cause Conformance failure.
The bootstrap lifecycle SHALL permit only candidate -> cutover and no reverse transition.
After cutover, bootstrap maintenance machinery SHALL NOT independently authorize mutation or create acceptance.

After cutover, FS0 SHALL complete bounded self-change through accepted authority, candidate publication, Conformance, Assurance, explicit acceptance, and accepted-state publication without the external bootstrap environment.
Every FS0 JSON record SHALL contain schema_version and record_type.
Each FS0 authority record SHALL contain schema_version, record_type authority, authority_id, title, owner, lifecycle_state, dependencies, delegates, requirements, and provenance.
Each installed requirement record SHALL contain requirement_id, owner_authority_id, statement, lifecycle_state, lineage where applicable, conformance_applicability, and assurance_applicability.
FS0 SHALL maintain one machine-resolvable bootstrap state record containing lifecycle state, bootstrap provenance issue when established, accepted ref, and cutover timestamp when established.

The canonical repository-orientation surface SHALL state repository purpose, bootstrap/cutover status, Design Proposal discovery, accepted-state discovery, operation guidance, and limits on implementation/GitHub authority.
The canonical agent-orientation surface SHALL state initial reading order, Design-chunk discovery, bootstrap/cutover-state discovery, and accepted-state resolution after cutover.
Bootstrap verification SHALL fail if any required generated orientation or license surface is absent.
